question: Characterizes the hydrogen bridges present in the alpha helix:

options.opb: Establish between amino and carbonyl groups of the peptide bonds.
options.opc: Involve groups charged positively and negatively.
options.opd: Set between groups of side chains.

analysis: Hydrogen bonds in the alpha helix are established between the amino and carbonyl groups of the peptide bonds, contributing to the secondary structure of proteins.
